latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Study Habit Builder.
- Guides parents in helping children develop consistent, independent study routines using habit-stacking and environmental design.
- Focuses on study process rather than academic content; does not provide subject instruction.
- Provides clear usage guidance, safety boundaries, and when to seek professional help.
- Includes a customizable, step-by-step framework: greeting, context assessment, habit diagnosis, habit-stacking plan, and follow-up.
